انتزعتما (form VIII)
# اِنْتَزَعْتُمَا (intazaʕtumā) /in.ta.zaʕ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اُنْتُزِعْتُمَا (untuziʕtumā) /un.tu.ziʕ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
